# DockSplitterIframePane's passthrough arm reads an iframe that may not exist yet

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

The `components (1/3)` CI job fails now and then on pull requests that never touch the dock, always at the same arm of `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs`:

```
[chromium] › test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs:108:5 › DockSplitter — a drag whose path crosses an iframe › neo-drag-passthrough opts an iframe out of the gesture shield
Error: page.evaluate: TypeError: Failed to execute 'getComputedStyle' on 'Window': parameter 1 is not of type 'Element'.
```

Seen at least six times since September: #18708 (Sep 14), #19708 (Oct 13), #20630 (Nov 9), #21225 (Nov 17), #21154 and #21250 (Nov 17), #21315 (Nov 18, run 44255221917). Each time a rerun of the failed job passed, and the spec passes locally (`components` shard 1/3: 219 of 219 on Nov 18). Every pull request it hits pays a rerun.

## The Problem

The `beforeEach` creates two iframes in the App worker, the plain one (`IFRAME_ID`) and right after it a passthrough sibling (`` `${IFRAME_ID}-passthrough` ``). Creating an instance returns once it is added, not once its DOM exists. The hook then waits for the plain iframe only:

```js
await page.waitForSelector('.neo-dashboard-dock-splitter', {state: 'attached'});
await page.waitForSelector(`#${IFRAME_ID}`,                {state: 'attached'})
```

The arm at line 108 reads both iframes with `getComputedStyle(document.getElementById(...))`. On a slow runner the passthrough iframe is not attached yet, `getElementById` returns `null`, and `getComputedStyle(null)` throws.

## The Architectural Reality

- The test file is the only thing that changes; no engine source is involved.
- Design authority: n/a — the ticket calls no product behaviour wrong; it fixes a test that reads before its fixture is ready.

## The Fix

In the `beforeEach` of `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs`, wait for the passthrough iframe too, next to the two existing waits:

```js
await page.waitForSelector(`#${IFRAME_ID}-passthrough`, {state: 'attached'})
```

Keep the existing waits and the column alignment of the block (the repository's pre-commit hook checks it).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The `beforeEach` waits for both iframes before any arm runs.
- [ ] The spec passes 20 times in a row locally: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs --repeat-each=20`
- [ ] No other file changes.

## Out of Scope

- What the iframe shield does during a drag (#17883 and #17887 own that).
- Adding waits or retries inside the arms.

## Avoided Traps

- A fixed `waitForTimeout`: a sleep hides the race on a fast machine and loses it on a slow one. Wait for the element itself.
- Retrying the test in the Playwright config: it would hide this race and every future one.
